provenance.policy: Exact source text retained. Bounded declared payment programs cover fixed-number prices, announced-X prices, and resolving local-X selections. Resolving local X reads exact historical chosen-set cardinality and scopes downstream references. Whole-payment named receipts are a separate pending shared wrapper dependency; native verification pending.

mechanics.original_reminder: For two colors, tap an untapped creature you control of that color or exile a card of that color from your graveyard.
mechanics.executable_reminder: Choose {Number} untapped creatures you control or cards from your graveyard, each representing a different color it has. Tap the chosen creatures on the battlefield. Exile the chosen cards from your graveyard.

rule_text.name: 701.106a
rule_text.rule: "Collect backing N" means "For each of N different colors, tap an untapped creature you control of that color or exile a card of that color from your graveyard."

rule_text.name: 701.106b
rule_text.rule: If a player is given the choice to collect backing but is unable to complete the process N times, they can't choose to collect backing.

rule_text.name: 701.106c
rule_text.rule: A spell that has an ability that allows a player to collect backing as an additional cost to cast it may have another ability that refers to whether backing was collected. These abilities are linked. See rule 607, “Linked Abilities.”
